nameEn: Manufacture of other porcelain and ceramic products
description: This class includes the manufacture of household, ornamental and other porcelain and ceramic products.
includes: manufacture of ceramic household and ornamental articles: tableware, kitchenware, vases, ornaments
manufacture of ceramic sanitary fixtures: baths, bidets, sinks, wash basins, toilet pans
manufacture of ceramic insulators and insulating fittings
manufacture of ceramic and ferrite magnets
manufacture of ceramic floor and wall tiles
manufacture of ceramic laboratory, chemical and industrial products: troughs, tanks, tubes, crucibles
manufacture of artificial teeth, dental fittings and other ceramic dental products
excludes: manufacture of refractory ceramic goods, see 2391
manufacture of clay building materials, see 2392
manufacture of optical glass and optical elements, see 2670
